name: Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group Co., Ltd. (济南文旅发展集团有限公司)
via: Jinan SASAC holds 93.19% and is the largest shareholder and actual controller; Shandong Caixin Asset Operation Co., Ltd. holds 6.81%
note: First-level municipal state-owned enterprise of Jinan, established by the Jinan municipal government in June 2017. Manages and operates the First Spring Under Heaven (天下第一泉) 5A scenic area and Jinan Wildlife World, and is an investor in Shandong Taishan FC Co., Ltd., per the group's 2026 recruitment notice and press citing the national enterprise credit information system.
